description.value: Open since 1967, The Old Bavaria Haus is a nationally acclaimed German restaurant set inside a beautifully restored century-old home in the heart of New Westminster. The restaurant serves authentic Bavarian specialties — schnitzels, beef rouladen, bratwurst, spatzle — paired with German draft beers and wines. It accommodates everything from intimate family dinners to large corporate events and private parties, and also offers delivery through major platforms.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 38m; stands at 68m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active, full-service German restaurant at 233 6th St, New Westminster — the street address matches OSM but the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver', which contradicts the website's repeated 'New Westminster, BC V3L 3A5'. Takeout is confirmed via explicit mentions of DoorDash, Skip, and Uber Eats, and a dedicated take-out reservation option. No bike parking, bike rack, washroom, or water refill mentions appear anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently lists the address as New Westminster, BC V3L 3A5. The address has been corrected to the website value; OSM geocommunity may need updating.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Th 11:00-21:00; Fr-Su 10:00-21:00) conflicts substantially with the website (Tue-Sun 4 PM–9 PM, closed Mondays) — the OSM hours appear significantly out of date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed active by website content. Strong candidate for the directory as a full-service meal stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website notes ample free parking and wheelchair accessibility. Catering services available for off-site events.
